verdict.rationale: The H200 is hardware, but it ships with a software stack (CUDA Toolkit, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM microservices), so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. The evidence never mentions API versioning, release compatibility guarantees, or a deprecation policy for any of these. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, so no versioned API contract is evidenced.
